system.description:
You inject a disorienting spike of chakra into the mind of one creature you can see within range. Make a ranged Genjutsu attack, dealing 1d6 psychic damage. The target must also succeed an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, until the end of its next turn, it must roll a d4 and subtract the number from the first saving throw they make for the duration.

At Higher Levels: This Jutsu’s proficiency increases as you increase in level rolling an additional 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), 17th level (4d6)
